texts:
Grok Bot can make 3D now. One sentence adds the free studio at three.ws/grok as a custom MCP server, with no account and no key, and from then on text and images become textured 3D models, rigged avatars, and a talking 3D body Grok can wear.

Grok Bot runs on its own cloud computer, so a render that takes minutes on a cold GPU never hangs a task: every call answers within 40 seconds with the model or a job id, and Grok collects it with check_job. Limits follow your MCP session, not xAI's IP address, so one busy user never spends yours.

The 15 tools behind it are read live from the server's tools/list. Every 3D generation lane runs on @nvidia silicon; we are a member of NVIDIA Inception.

Three jobs on the page name the tools Grok calls in order: an asset pack from the CC0 catalog, a model with a page-ready embed, and a talking persona that lip-syncs a greeting. Six tested recipes and a skill file you can upload to Grok Skills sit beside them.
